description: This module is used to add/remove/change files in ISO file.

parameters.name: add_files
parameters.description: Allows to add and replace files in the ISO file. It creates intermediate folders inside the ISO file when they do not exist. Default: []

parameters.name: dest_file
parameters.description: The absolute path of the file inside the ISO file.

parameters.name: src_file
parameters.description: The path with file name on the machine the module is executed on.

parameters.name: delete_files
parameters.description: Absolute paths for files inside the ISO file that should be removed. Default: []

parameters.name: dest_iso
parameters.description: The path of the customized ISO file.

parameters.name: src_iso
parameters.description: This is the path of source ISO file.

examples:
- name: "Customize ISO file"
  community.general.iso_customize:
    src_iso: "/path/to/ubuntu-22.04-desktop-amd64.iso"
    dest_iso: "/path/to/ubuntu-22.04-desktop-amd64-customized.iso"
    delete_files:
      - "/boot.catalog"
    add_files:
      - src_file: "/path/to/grub.cfg"
        dest_file: "/boot/grub/grub.cfg"
      - src_file: "/path/to/ubuntu.seed"
        dest_file: "/preseed/ubuntu.seed"
  register: customize_iso_result

return_values.name: dest_iso
return_values.description: Path of the customized ISO file. Returned: on success Sample: "/path/to/customized.iso"

return_values.name: src_iso
return_values.description: Path of source ISO file. Returned: on success Sample: "/path/to/file.iso"
